bounded_recommendations: Keep existing enemy HP for the first campaign budget pass; use measured finite ammo and actual encounter exposure before increasing durability.

Twin buys immediate close heavy-target removal for two shells, not general shell efficiency. Preserve Shotgun as the cheaper close/light-target and medium-range option; test clustered threats before any Twin spread changes.

Rivet is the rapid precise long-range role, including correctly mapped hardware contacts. Do not describe it as armor-piercing: armor currently changes contact feedback/gib threshold, not damage resistance.

Single-target perfect Pistol/Rivet aim suppresses all attacks with current guaranteed pain. Keep hurt interruption; create simultaneous threats from distinct angles, usable cover and finite precision ammo rather than adding stealth pain immunity or HP padding.

At25m every ranged species is outside its14/18/20m release range. Use encounter geometry/range that allows readable ranged commitments, rather than assuming distant visible shooters can immediately threaten.
Siege is one-rocket direct removal plus visible-area crowd damage; maintain physical blast blockers and close self-risk. Budget rockets against group opportunities, not only one-target HP totals.
limitations: One deterministic accepted-shot seed sequence per stationary torso target; spread contact/TTK is not a statistical hit probability or all-angle moving-target estimate.
TTK starts at the first accepted shot: one hitscan kill reads zero; reaction/aim/switch time excluded; projectile travel included.
Matrix intentionally reselects the ordinary idle pose between volleys to isolate distance/native silhouette; full live AI and pain pose pressure measured separately.
scope: Independent source-runtime fixed-60Hz calibration using actual Combat.try_fire, native-alpha hurt geometry, swept ordnance, full AI attack ticks and authoritative events. Matrix targets/player stationary; torso aim uses nearest actual opaque triangle and camera-center shots, not physical mouse input, normal encounters, exported executable or human acceptance. Inventory grants are fixture-only, enemies retain current source HP/damage.
source_facts: Rivet precise contact deals 36 on mapped flesh and armor; no armor-specific damage multiplier exists.
Every nonlethal hit resets pain/state_time and cancels unreleased attacks; preserve that interruption contract.
Siege aggregates 120 direct + 90 contact blast once; radial 90 falls off over 4.8m and world layer blocks it; player self blast uses separate60 maximum before armor.
